mapper.insert: insert into global_setting (house_id, aphrodisiac_days, palpation_days, prepartum_days, weaning_days, postpartum_days, sale_days, replacement_days, remark, create_by, update_by) values (#{houseId}, #{aphrodisiacDays}, #{palpationDays}, #{prepartumDays}, #{weaningDays}, #{postpartumDays}, #{saleDays}, #{replacementDays}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: select id, house_id, aphrodisiac_days, palpation_days, prepartum_days, weaning_days, postpartum_days, sale_days, replacement_days, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from global_setting where house_id = #{houseId}
mapper.update: update global_setting set aphrodisiac_days = #{aphrodisiacDays}, palpation_days = #{palpationDays}, prepartum_days = #{prepartumDays}, weaning_days = #{weaningDays}, postpartum_days = #{postpartumDays}, sale_days = #{saleDays}, replacement_days = #{replacementDays}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where house_id = #{houseId}
